statement: Community trigger encoder defines Weapon 0x25 as LE16 two-position zone bitmask at params[0..1], force level minus one at params[2]; Feedback 0x21 and Vibration 0x26 use LE16 active-zone mask at params[0..1], LE32 3-bit-per-zone force bits at params[2..5], with Vibration frequency at params[8]; Off 0x05 zeroes remaining params.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: adaptive-triggers.js 72-95. These are supported example format definitions, not an exhaustive firmware mode table or independently validated actuator waveform.
